create_PACOEval_instance: create a PACOEval instance for evaluating part segmentation and object detection on PACO datasets
run_PACOEval_evaluation: run full PACO evaluation including object and joint attribute level AP and AR metrics
calculate_part_mask_area_outside_obj: calculate the overlap precision of predicted parts outside their parent object masks
calculate_part_box_area_outside_obj: calculate the overlap precision of predicted parts outside their parent object bounding boxes
summarize_PACOEval_results: summarize PACO evaluation results with AP, AP50, AP75, APs, APm, APl, and AR metrics
